class.name: HTMLEvent
class.brief_description: A DOM event delivered to element listeners.
class.description: Events are created by the engine for real input and layout activity, and by scripts for synthetic dispatch. Scripts assign [member type], [member bubbles], and [member cancelable] before calling [method HTMLEventTarget.dispatch_event]. [member target], [member current_target], [member event_phase], and [member default_prevented] are read-only and controlled by the dispatcher. The propagation path runs from the window through the document node and the element chain to the target. [method composed_path] returns that path during dispatch and an empty array after dispatch ends. The [member composed] flag controls whether events originating in a shadow tree cross its boundary. Targets are retargeted to the host for listeners outside that tree. Listeners registered with [code]passive[/code] cannot cancel the default action. [method prevent_default] cancels the built-in action that follows the event, such as following a link, activating a button, toggling a checkbox, or inserting typed text. [method HTMLNode.dispatch_event] returns [code]false[/code] when the default action was cancelled. When a listener cancels an event, the [HTMLLabel] signal that reports the same action is not emitted. Events without listeners behave exactly like the documented signal-only API.

method.name: composed_path
method.description: Returns the propagation path of the current dispatch, with the target first and the window last. The array is empty outside event dispatch.

method.name: prevent_default
method.description: Cancels the built-in action for this event. Has no effect unless [member cancelable] is [code]true[/code], or when the running listener was registered with [code]passive[/code].

method.name: stop_propagation
method.description: Stops the event from reaching later nodes in the propagation path. Listeners already queued on the current node still run.

method.name: stop_immediate_propagation
method.description: Stops the event from reaching later nodes and skips the remaining listeners registered on the current node.

members.member: The event type, such as [code]click[/code] or [code]keydown[/code]. Assignment is ignored while the event is being dispatched.
The target the event was dispatched to. It does not change during propagation.
The target whose listeners are running. Use it to implement a listener shared by several targets.
The propagation phase the event is currently in.
If [code]true[/code], the event propagates from the target's parent up to the document node after the target phase. Assignment is ignored while the event is being dispatched.
If [code]true[/code], [method prevent_default] can cancel the built-in action. Assignment is ignored while the event is being dispatched.
Whether an event originating in a shadow tree can propagate across its boundary.
Whether a listener cancelled the built-in action.
Whether the engine synthesized the event from real input. Events created by scripts report [code]false[/code].
The millisecond timestamp taken when the event was first dispatched.

constants.constant: The event is not being dispatched.
The event is travelling from the document down to the target's parent.
The event is at its target.
The event is travelling from the target's parent up to the document node.
